notes: FleetComm 1.4.7 — joint task force, field-tested. An allied operator now gets relay access the moment they first sign in (the previous build could show a net and then refuse it). COMMAND: MAKE ORG LEAD on an allied row lets that organization’s lead create, rename and delete nets inside their own organization’s nets, and nowhere else — the relay enforces it. Allied operators see subnets under their nets as they are added.
